thread:
elena: Prod canary is spiking 5xx on /embeddings after the last image. Need an expedited hotpatch rollout. Can we skip the remaining canary and push a fix? @ops-oncall @raj

deploy-bot: [deploybot] Canary status snapshot: 2% traffic -> error rate 7.8% (5xx). recent deploy image: r2026-03-20-hotfix. Autopause: false.

raj: What are rollback criteria if the error rate doesn't drop? We need a pinned fallback image and a clear trigger.

sam: Quick checklist: 1) pin image, 2) enable circuit-breaker timeout, 3) ensure alerting & runbook linked, 4) notify oncall. Runbook: https://go/reverts/hotpatch

elena: Pinning to image r2026-03-20-hotfix+kvfix (KV cache key fix). Proposed deploy command:```./deploy --service embeddings --image r2026-03-20-hotfix+kvfix --canary 0->100 --note "kv cache fix"```Would like to start rollout now and keep tight rollback rules.

katie: +1 from SRE. :thumbsup:

ops-oncall: I'm oncall and give emergency rollout approval. Filing incident INC-3489, will monitor. Keep me on the thread.

raj: Approve from eng with condition: set circuit-breaker timeout 1.5s and set automatic rollback if errors > 3% for 5m. Fallback image: r2026-03-19-stable.

sam: Added the canary monitors and the runbook to the incident ticket (INC-3489). Also added a quick smoke test: curl -sS https://api/embeddings/health | jq .status

deploy-bot: [deploybot] Starting rollout: image r2026-03-20-hotfix+kvfix -> 20% at 1792468130.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] Canary metrics at 20%: errors 0.9% — trending down.

elena: Release note snippet: "Fix KV cache keying that caused intermittent 5xx on embeddings; reduces tail errors for small batches." Will merge full note to changelog after this. cc @marketing

ops-oncall: Watching metrics. If errors spike >3% or p95 latency >2s we revert to r2026-03-19-stable as per rollback rule.

katie: Dashboards look healthy, setting alerts for the thresholds. :eyes: 

deploy-bot: [deploybot] Rollout complete -> 100% at 1792468190. No rollback triggered.

elena: Closing thread — patch rolled to prod and incident ticket updated with postmortem checklist. Raising PR to merge release notes. Thanks everyone!
